name: Xero

verdict.topBlocker: Entering the wrong approval path (standard tier upgrade vs. Financial Services Partnership queue for payment/lending use cases) or hitting connection limits before approval.
verdict.summary: Xero provides self-serve OAuth configuration and developer account creation, allowing up to a low limit of connected organizations before formal review is required. Scaling beyond self-serve ceilings or handling financial services triggers multi-week partner review queues.

steps.title: Create a Developer Account and App
steps.detail: Register on the Xero Developer Portal, enter your company or application URL, agree to terms, and create your app to receive credentials.

steps.title: Configure Redirect URIs and Scopes
steps.detail: Set up your absolute redirect URIs (up to 50 allowed, no wildcards) and configure your required scopes in the app settings.

steps.title: Generate and Secure Client Secret
steps.detail: Generate a client secret in the developer console and store it securely since it will not be shown again once you leave the page.

steps.title: Implement Authorization Code Flow with PKCE
steps.detail: Write the code for handling the OAuth 2.0 authorization endpoint and token exchange, utilizing PKCE if building a native or public client app.

steps.title: Test Local OAuth Connection Flow
steps.detail: Execute a test authorization flow against a Demo Company or test organization using your newly created app credentials.

steps.title: Determine App Partnership / Review Path
steps.detail: Identify whether your product requires a standard tier upgrade/certification or the Financial Services Partnership queue.

steps.title: Submit App Partner or Financial Services Application
steps.detail: Submit your application form detailing your end-user journey, data usage, and requested scopes to Xero.

steps.title: Undergo Xero Review and App Walkthrough
steps.detail: Wait for Xero to review your integration, conduct end-user journey demonstrations (connection, mapping, disconnection), and verify security practices.

requirements.note: Company or application URL must be provided when registering your app.
Xero reviews the actual product experience, so expect to demo account mapping, connection management, and disconnection flows during partner review.
Financial service providers or apps scaling past self-serve connection limits must complete partner applications and contract reviews.

scopes.note: Required for single sign-on and retrieving basic user identity details.
Required to get a refresh token in order to maintain an offline connection and refresh access tokens.
Standard organisation accounting scopes. Web and PKCE apps created after March 2026 use granular scopes by default.

scopes.scope: bankfeedsv2 / payment services / practice manager scopes
scopes.note: Specialized scopes that require additional certification, partner registration, security questionnaires, and commercial agreements.

blockers.symptom: Application stuck in standard review queue for months
blockers.cause: Applying through the standard self-service or tier upgrade path when your app performs financial services (e.g., pulling invoices for payment, lending, or credit decisioning).
blockers.unblock: Apply directly through Xero's Financial Services Partnership queue from the start of integration work.

blockers.symptom: Users hit 'maximum number of uncertified apps they can install' error
blockers.cause: Xero restricts individual users to installing a maximum of 2 uncertified apps.
blockers.unblock: Successfully complete the Xero certification process or have users remove an existing uncertified app.

blockers.symptom: Redirect URI mismatch error during OAuth flow
blockers.cause: Using wildcards in redirect URIs or mismatching absolute URLs configured in the developer portal.
blockers.unblock: Ensure all redirect URIs are absolute URLs without wildcards (up to 50 supported) matching the exact request string.
